name: Rhino Workout
description:
RHINO RACING CLUB — THURSDAY WINTER WORKOUT SERIES

After a great first winter, Rhino Racing Club is bringing the series back starting Oct 15 — another 20–22 weeks of progressive Zwift training to help us build fitness through the winter and come into spring stronger.

Sweet Spot — 8 weeks | Oct 15–Dec 3

Threshold — 6 weeks | Dec 10–Jan 14

VO₂ Max — 6–8 weeks | Jan 21–March

We’ll generally follow a 3-week build + 1-week recovery rhythm. The goal isn’t to smash ourselves every Thursday — it’s to build fitness progressively, stay consistent and train together through the winter.

Every Thursday is a structured, banded Rhino Racing Club group workout, so different abilities and FTPs can ride together. Our Yellow Beacon will keep the group together and provide cues throughout the ride on pacing, effort and the purpose of each workout.

First 4 weeks:

• Nov 12 - Crisscross Tempo/SweetSpot 10 min easy warm-up → 3 × [2 min Tempo / 3 min Sweet Spot / 2 min Tempo / 3 min Sweet Spot] → 5 min easy → 10 min easy endurance → 5 min cool-down.

• Nov 19 - Crisscross 3 × [3 min Tempo / 4 min Sweet Spot / 3 min Tempo / 4 min Sweet Spot]

• Nov 26: Crisscross 3 × [3 min Tempo / 5 min Sweet Spot / 3 min Tempo / 5 min Sweet Spot]

• Dec 3 — Recovery Week

The workouts are selected from the Fast Cat Coaching training library, which includes more than 600 workouts and 100 training plans during its 30-day trial.

Whether you’re racing, training for an event, building fitness or just looking for a supportive group to train with this winter — come ride with the Rhinos.

If you’re training for a spring event or getting ready for the 2027 season, this series is a great weekly session to complement your training plan. Add your endurance work, recovery and strength sessions around it, and you’ve got a solid winter foundation.

You bring the legs. We’ll bring the suffering. 😈🦏

🔗 https://www.zwift.com/uk/events/tag/rhinoworkout

Consistency wins. See you Thursday! DM if you have questions

name: Run in the Park Autumn Run League - Week 6
description:
IMPORTANT: You must be registered with ZwiftPower for your result to be included in the official Run in the Park results at www.runinthepark.co.uk

Run in the Park Autumn Run League 2026

Join us for a 6-week Zwift running league with a different route and distance each week.

Each round awards league points based on your finishing position within your group, with your best 5 results from 6 counting towards the final standings.

Choose your group based on your current 5K average pace:

A – Faster than 4:29 min/km
B – 4:29 to 5:00 min/km
C – 5:00 to 5:46 min/km
D – Slower than 5:46 min/km

Please choose your group honestly. Your group should be based on your normal 5K ability rather than the distance or expected pace of that week's race.  Runners exceeding the group threshold maybe promoted to the faster group in the results.

Autumn League routes:

Week 1 – Makuri Islands – Mech Isle Loop – 4.1 km
Week 2 – New York – Shuman Trail Loop – 2.8 km
Week 3 – Paris – Rues in Rythme – 5.3 km
Week 4 – Watopia – Splash and Dash – 6.2 km
Week 5 – Yorkshire – Queen's Highway – 5.6 km
Week 6 – Scotland – Glasgow Crit Circuit – 3.2 km

The league starts on Thursday 8 October, with events scheduled at 2-hour intervals throughout the day.

After the league is decided, Week 7 is the Queen Stage – a special 10 km mass-start finale.

The Queen Stage does not count towards the league standings. All groups start together for one final race, with overall and group honours up for grabs.

6 scoring rounds. Best 5 count. One 10K Queen Stage finale.

name: AATC Thursday Interval Workout
description:
WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Dana of the Ann Arbor Triathlon Club - Group workouts make training so much more fun. The Ann Arbor Triathlon Club promotes the sport of triathlon in Southeast Michigan. We have all levels of Triathletes.  

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. 

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: Faster Masters A/B/C Team Pursuit
description:
Thursdays’ Team Pursuit includes three teams starting at different times. Team C will start first followed by Team B, with Team A departing last. The goal is for the faster teams behind to catch Team C during the ride while all three teams hold their respective advertised paces. Starting time gaps may be adjusted during the season to maintain the ride concept, that being: as faster teams catch the team(s) in front, the catch will offer riders in a slower group who wish to increase their effort to do so by joining the faster team as they pass. Additionally, the catch offers riders in the faster team(s) the opportunity to jump in with the slower team(s) and recover to the finish. Riders who jump onto a faster team may realize they cannot hold the pace have an option to fall back to their starting group and try the same the next week to see if they can hold on longer. This is a great way to get stronger riding in a team format. 

All rides include a 30-minute Late Join period. During this time, dropped riders can use Late Join to rejoin their team. If you find that the team you selected is either too fast or too slow for your pace, you can switch teams within the first 30 minutes of the start time of the team you would like to join by using Late Join. 

We do not sweep during the first 30 minutes of a ride. If you fall behind for any reason during this time, we recommend using Late Join. We usually do not have designated sweepers (Red Beacon). After the first 30 minutes, if you get dropped and want to rejoin your team, please send a message in the format HELP(X), where X is the number of seconds you are off the back (for example, HELP5). If you reach out early, one or more stronger riders may come to assist you. If a sweep is needed we recommend you message help within 10 seconds.

We look forward to having you join us. The team pursuit is an excellent endurance and strength building adventure. 

Connect with Faster Masters on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/2286721591625605

name: RO4H "Aaahh, Thursday!" Social Ride
description:
Welcome to the RO4H “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride.

The RO4H “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community. We foster a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere that embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.

The pace varies depending on the terrain, but the ride will have an overall average pace of around 18–20 MPH (27–32 KPH). The pace on the flats sections will be slightly faster in the peloton and be sub 2 W/KG on climbs. We typically ride mostly flat routes with only a few short hills, if any. Sometimes we take on some slightly hillier routes for variety, but most of our rides will be gently rolling to flat terrain.

We try to be a no-drop ride, but ultimately, this pace is a recovery pace for some and a great effort for others. You should be prepared to meet the average pace and strive to stay in the ride leader's peloton to benefit from the group draft effect. Being a social ride, we don’t chase flyers — but flyers are free to fly. The “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride is certainly not a race.

Sweepers are available to assist those off the back. We do not want anyone to ride alone unless they choose. The sweepers will variably help riders bridge to the leader's peloton or form a second pace group. We do not want riders to ride alone unless they want to.

Join us for the RO4H “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride —you'll almost certainly break a sweat, hear a few dad jokes, and might even have fun.

View the RO4H ride schedule: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/ro4h

Look us up on FB: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZwiftRideOn4Health/

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Loopin Lava | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: USMeS Movement Drill
description:
Welcome to USMeS Movement Drill
This session is a step up and designed to prepare you for Force Development immediately following. The focus is on coordinated movement, controlled pressure, and working together while the intensity nudges a tad higher.

✅ Pace: an average of 1.8–2.2 w/kg
✅ Duration: 55 minutes

While we aim for an overall ~2.1w/kg average, ( 'ISH ), we do push on climbs, and sprints WILL be encouraged. When the pace lifts, make your move, then fall back in quickly and keep the group intact.

Ride sharp, respect the leader, and protect the group.
This is where we wake things up.
Move well now. Be ready to apply what you've learned, @Force Development, next.

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: The HERD Thirsty Thursday
description:
The Herd's Thirsty Thursday (THTT) Dual Pace Social Group Ride

This group ride offers a dual pace in a social environment. The goal is to keep our rides entertaining with games and trivia, educational with Zwift tips, and on pace. This ride offer our traditional Cat “D” option or a slightly higher paced Cat “C” option.

Our ride leaders’ goal is to keep to the advertised pace, averaged over the course of the ride. However, bear in mind that there are situations such as incline and descents that will affect the pace. To this, we ask that you pay attention to the rider leader announcements and adjust your pace accordingly. Stay close to the yellow beacon where the draft is most effective. As is customary to all Herd rides, we offer full Yellow (Ride Leader) and Red beacon (Sweeps) support.

If you find yourself wanting more of a challenge, we encourage you to join our sweep team as they ride “sweep-tervals” (above advertised pace) to help bring riders back to the ride leader.

Riding alone is not an option, as Herd rides are geared to be inclusive and fun.

#herd

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.

name: BMC/Walmart Cycling Club Social
description:
Join the BMC/Walmart Cycling Club for a spirited group ride on this frozen arctic-blast night! (For much of the USA, at least) This is a social ride, with some spice. It is all about fun. Feel free to fly but it is more fun to ride together. Beacon will maintain prescribed pace with the potential for a few spicy moments. Sweepers will be back. All will be keeping the good vibes strong!
The BMC / Walmart Cycling Team was born to promote fitness through cycling in NWA. We are a group of enthusiasts cyclists and professional racers participating in all the different disciplines cycling has to offer. BMC is a cycling club located in and around Northwest Arkansas formed in 1979 by among others, the late Joe Martin. We are roadies, mountain bikers, tandem riders, tri-athletes, unicyclists, etc. We ride bicycles and that’s our “community”. Visit http://www.ridebmc.com to learn more or to join the club!

name: ZLDR Mid-Week Long Run
description:
Welcome to the ZLDR 21.1k Mid-Week Long Run. Whether you come for 3k, 5k, 10k or the full distance we are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners who will do our best to help you reach your goals.

Whether you’re speeding across the roads of Makuri or taking a gentle jog, join us for whatever distance but keep joining us and we can help you get to 21.1k and beyond. It’s always easier to run with others.

Not everyone gets the weekend off. For those of us who give our lives over to work on the weekends, please join us every week for your mid-week long run!

We’ve got 21.1km (13.1 miles) set aside just for you! Run as little or as much as you’d like, feel free to run more, to work in your interval training, to ease in a few recovery miles…. Whatever your mid-week goal may be, we’re here to help make it possible!

As with any of our runs, you are not required to go the entire distance listed. But we are a distance running group and would like to offer our members a chance every week to put their legs to the test and see how far they can go.

Hope to see you there!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

name: Run in the Park Autumn Run League - Week 6
description:
IMPORTANT: You must be registered with ZwiftPower for your result to be included in the official Run in the Park results at www.runinthepark.co.uk

Run in the Park Autumn Run League 2026

Join us for a 6-week Zwift running league with a different route and distance each week.

Each round awards league points based on your finishing position within your group, with your best 5 results from 6 counting towards the final standings.

Choose your group based on your current 5K average pace:

A – Faster than 4:29 min/km
B – 4:29 to 5:00 min/km
C – 5:00 to 5:46 min/km
D – Slower than 5:46 min/km

Please choose your group honestly. Your group should be based on your normal 5K ability rather than the distance or expected pace of that week's race.  Runners exceeding the group threshold maybe promoted to the faster group in the results.

Autumn League routes:

Week 1 – Makuri Islands – Mech Isle Loop – 4.1 km
Week 2 – New York – Shuman Trail Loop – 2.8 km
Week 3 – Paris – Rues in Rythme – 5.3 km
Week 4 – Watopia – Splash and Dash – 6.2 km
Week 5 – Yorkshire – Queen's Highway – 5.6 km
Week 6 – Scotland – Glasgow Crit Circuit – 3.2 km

The league starts on Thursday 8 October, with events scheduled at 2-hour intervals throughout the day.

After the league is decided, Week 7 is the Queen Stage – a special 10 km mass-start finale.

The Queen Stage does not count towards the league standings. All groups start together for one final race, with overall and group honours up for grabs.

6 scoring rounds. Best 5 count. One 10K Queen Stage finale.

name: USMeS Force Development Vanguard
description:
Welcome to USMeS Force Development Vanguard!
The forward element is reporting for duty, and we're leading the charge into Thursday!

✅ Average: 2.2–2.8 w/kg
✅ Duration: 60 Minutes

Vanguard is all about taking the initiative and bringing some firepower to the front of the formation. Expect a solid C paced group ride with opportunities to push on the climbs, attack the segments, and let those legs loose when a sprint banner comes into view.

Our target is an overall average of 2.2–2.8 w/kg, but that doesn't mean every mile or km needs to be steady. A little friendly competition is encouraged, and we fully expect a few riders to test their legs along the way!

Make your move, enjoy the effort, then fall back in quickly. Respect the ride leader, regroup after your attacks, and keep the unit moving together.
Vanguard leads from the front. Let's bring the firepower!

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: Film My Run 500 with Noble Pro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

Join the FMR Run Club for more fun events at https://www.zwift.com/uk/clubs/6afca04c-8fac-4ffa-b700-f27a73d7f3dd/join

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Loopin Lava | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

description:
Welcome to USMeS Force Development Overwatch!
Vanguard may have led the advance, but the mission isn't complete until Overwatch has done its job!

Overwatch is our later deployment, bringing the same intensity, teamwork, and competitive spirit to the battlefield. We'll hold a solid C paced group effort while leaving plenty of room to turn up the watts on the climbs, chase a segment, or launch an attack toward a sprint banner.

Attack the segments, then fall back in quickly. Respect the ride leader, regroup, and help keep the formation intact. There's plenty of room for individual firepower, but teamwork keeps the mission moving.

name: "Russian Step - Hamster Style"
description:
“Russian Step - Hamster Style” is a cadence game where your legs spin like a hamster wheel! Alternate between high-speed spins (100–120 RPM) and controlled strength efforts (60–75 RPM). It builds coordination, pedaling efficiency, and muscle activation. Stay focused and flow with the rhythm. Let’s spin like warriors!
The “Russian Step - Hamster Style” workout is perfect for those aiming to improve cadence agility, pedaling efficiency, and neuromuscular responsiveness. By alternating very high RPM efforts with slower, strength-focused segments, it trains your body to handle sudden changes in rhythm and builds muscular coordination. It’s an excellent session for riders of all levels who want to break routine, sharpen their pedal stroke, and have fun while training. It also keeps the mind engaged and legs responsive.
⸻

        •        Warm-up (10 min):
        •        Easy spin at 90 RPM, gradually increasing power to 60% FTP.
        •        Main set (45 min):
        •        6 x (6 min intervals):
        •        1 min @ 80% FTP, 65 RPM
        •        1 min @ 95% FTP, 90 RPM
        •        30 sec @ 110 RPM, 70% FTP
        •        30 sec @ 60 RPM, 90% FTP
        •        1 min @ 100 RPM, 75% FTP
        •        1 min recovery @ 50% FTP, 85 RPM
        •        Finale (5 min):
        •        Progressive cadence ramp: start at 85 RPM, increase 5 RPM every minute
        •        Cool-down (10 min):
        •        Easy spin at 60% FTP, 85 RPM

name: Watopia Dawn Patrol
description:
Welcome to Watopia Dawn Patrol hosted by Oslo Dawn Patrol.

The Dawn Patrol rides are an early morning social workout spin originating in Oslo, Norway that has since been adopted by local riders in several cities across the country and Europe. While a core group of riders braces the elements outdoors all year round, many of us take to the indoors during the winter season, bringing Watopia Dawn Patrol to life.

We head out for a ~60 min pre-work spin around the event-only route The Magnificent 8. This is a social group ride averaging no more than 3 W/kg with a little race up the reverse Hilly KOM. Stop pedalling after you’ve finished the Zwift KOM to regroup, and we will ride the remainder of the route together.

LEADER'S PACE:
- 2.0 W/kg out of the starting pen (we recommend you warm up to that pace 5 min before the start)
- 2.5-2.7 W/kg on flat sections
- 2.7-3.0 W/kg on climbs

REGROUP:
We regroup after the descent following the Hilly KOM, between km 11-11.3 (before the left turn that takes us to the Fuego Flats). Come to a complete stop until the ride leader announces that we are ready to continue.

WANNA RIDE HARDER?
If you're feeling strong and want to ride harder, a fantastic way to do this with the group is by dropping back to lend a wheel to someone who has fallen off the back for any reason.

You are welcome to join our Discord for the ride: https://discord.gg/3tTtcUm

Please tag @oslodawnpatrol in your Instagram updates.

Information and photos from the ride: https://www.facebook.com/OsloCyclingProject/

🪓 Choose your clan:
D Pace Shieldmaidens & Shieldbearers – A steady cruise for recovery or newer riders
C Pace Berserkers – A stronger effort for those ready to hammer the hills together

Together, we ride in formation, keep the group tight, and motivate like true Vikings. Expect banter, encouragement, maybe a few horns sounding as we charge into the weekend.

💥 No battles, no drops – just a crew of legends making every watt count. Whether you're in it for the laughs, the training, or the Valhalla vibes – we’ve got a place for you in the pack.
Grab your gear, summon your inner warrior, and ride with us. The gates of the weekend are open – let’s storm them together!

name: THE VIBE SHIFT
description:
Welcome to The Vibe Shift presented by ZDR, your new favorite Friday morning kick-off. Steady endurance, good vibes, fast TT bikes and working together to make every mile count. 

This is a true long-distance endurance ride designed to build aerobic fitness, maintain a consistent power pace and rack up those miles and XP. 

We’re here to keep the pressure on the pedals, find our rhythm and make the most of our time on the bike - all while enjoying some friendly chat along the way.

All riders are welcome. No discrimination, no egos - just good people, good vibes and a shared love for riding.
This is about finding the flow, not chasing the pace. No attacking, no pointless surges and no turning every incline into a competition. We ride together, keep the effort controlled and help maintain group cohesion.

A few things to keep in mind: 

While all riders will be assigned a fast TT bike with the fastest wheelset in draft mode, you will still be upgrading your bike of choice selected in your garage before starting the ride.

Steady power, steady progress. The aim is to stay within a consistent endurance power range. Save the big efforts for another day.

Ride as a group. Listen to the ride leader, follow their pacing guidance and help keep the group together.
Settle in, fuel properly and embrace the long game. This is about sustainable effort, not short bursts of glory.

Late join is welcome. Join within the first 30 minutes if you can and settle into the group as smoothly as possible.

Sweeps when needed. Nobody should feel abandoned. If you’re struggling to hold the group, speak up early so we can work out the best way to help.

Be smart on climbs. Follow the leader’s instructions and keep the effort controlled. If you want to push harder, take a pull on the flats rather than disrupting the group on every climb.

Respect the pace. This is endurance training, not a hard-climb-and-coast ride. Consistency is the point.
And above all, be a decent human being.

We train together, support each other and make the long hours count. Whether you’re here for the endurance, the XP, the upgrades or simply the company, you’re part of the group.

Steady miles. Good vibes. Start your weekend in the right gear.

name: 3R VOLT Interval Ride [~2.6-3.2 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 3R VOLT runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.8-3.2 w/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides and training needs, the following is a typical week:
Monday – After what has hopefully been a fun backed weekend on the bike, this our recovery session
Tuesday – Tends to be more of a classic interval session, riders usually finish with an average of around 3.0w/kg
Wednesday – We take to the hills and one of our tougher sessions with riders averaging around 3.2w/kg
Thursday – is our no red beacon ride and again tough interval sets and riders finishing around 3.2w/kg
Friday - is a little different, we don't take ourselves too seriously and often play a variety of games and quizzes along side the intervals and riders end up with around 2.8-3.0w/kg

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some may take up to 75mins with the majority finishing with either a ramp or a mini race.

The group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the VOLT discord server and features a friendly bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

This group ride is not a race so. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

Wednesday – We take to the hills and one of our tougher sessions with riders averaging around 3.2w/kg
Thursday – is our no red beacon ride and again tough interval sets and riders finishing around 3.2w/kg
Friday - is a little different, we don't take ourselves too seriously and often play a variety of games and quizzes along side the intervals and riders end up with around 2.8-3.0w/kg

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some may take up to 75mins with the majority finishing with either a ramp or a mini race.

The group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the VOLT discord server and features a friendly bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Valley Tempo
description:
Created by Mountain Massif in collaboration with Vekta, this structured training session is part of an 8-week plan designed to get you fit and back to your best. The plan was built using AI and years of real training data held in Vekta, learning from what has worked before to create a progressive programme of three sessions a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. This is week 1, Friday.  About the session: Three blocks of steady tempo through the valley. Builds the aerobic engine every climber needs, at a pace you can chat through - just.
Session details:
Warm Up 
10 min 45%–70% FTP

3 x Efforts 
10 min 82% FTP, 90 rpm
3 min recovery between efforts @ 55% FTP

Five minutes of easy endurance 
5 min 65% FTP, free cadence

Cool Down 
6 min 40%–55% FTP

Total Time: 57 minutes

Key coaching cues:
Ride it at a pace where you could still say a short sentence. Ride in ERG mode: every target is a percentage of your FTP, so the session suits all levels.

Safety Note:  Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information: For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home
To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

name: INC Relentless Intervals
description:
These regular training sessions will focus on various different areas for improvement in preparation for racing and events over the spring and summer in the Northern Hemisphere.

All sessions will be 60 minutes long and will include a warm up, so just grab your bottles and head straight to the pen. Sessions will vary between Push sessions, designed to lift your FTP with sub-threshold work, for longer periods of time; to Pull sessions, with shorter, harder, intervals above FTP, to “Pull” your FTP up from above.

These are no sweep training rides; if you drop from the group, simply continue the workout on your own or with others of a similar pace. This is an Innovation Cycling Training Ride Event – all riders are welcome. These events are put together to push you further than before, if you are feeling fresh hop on the front, if you need rest surf the draft.

name: Friday Rocacorba Collective - non-coached workout
description:
Every Thursday, our Training Members are put through their paces by Coach Helen Bridgman, a session that blends structure, intensity, and motivation to get the very best out of your legs.

But why keep all the good stuff to ourselves? Every Friday, we release that same workout for everyone to ride, just jump in when it suits you. Whether you’re chasing watts, building endurance, or just curious to see how we train, this is your chance to experience a Rocacorba Collective session from the inside.

Put on your favourite playlist, settle into the rhythm, and push yourself at your own pace.

Session : Aerobic Engine Builder 3x8

Warm Up:
5 min z2
2 × 1 min z3, 1 min easy
3 × 20 sec fast legs (over 100rpm) / 40 sec easy
2 min z2

Main Workout 3x8 mins:
2 min @ 80-82%
2 min @ 88-90%
2 min @ 80-82%
2 min @ 90-92%
3 min easy between blocks

Finish with 4 mins in z3, followed by a 5 min ramp down to z2 to finish, gradually reducing power and HR.

eventSubgroups.name: Friday Rocacorba Collective - non-coached workout (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
Every Thursday, our Training Members are put through their paces by Coach Helen Bridgman, a session that blends structure, intensity, and motivation to get the very best out of your legs.

But why keep all the good stuff to ourselves? Every Friday, we release that same workout for everyone to ride, just jump in when it suits you. Whether you’re chasing watts, building endurance, or just curious to see how we train, this is your chance to experience a Rocacorba Collective session from the inside.

Put on your favourite playlist, settle into the rhythm, and push yourself at your own pace.

Session: VO2 6x2 min with sprint finish

Gradual warm up over 6 mins starting at 50% FTP, gradually increasing HR and power to 70% FTP. 5 x 30s on and 30s off to really get the HR going!

The main blocks are 6 x 2 min VO2 Max with a 20s sprint at the end and 5 min recoveries in between. Try to do these on a hill if you can. Stay seated for the 2 min VO2 and get out of the saddle for the 20s sprint at the end.

Cool down for 10 min easy at the end.

This session will help increase your peak aerobic power, make you more aerobically efficient and improve your endurance.

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Loopin Lava | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

Paolo’s indoor training workouts have different lenghts to meet every athlete needs.

Paolo writes news and points of view for scannellatoriseriali.com

description:
Welcome to [ASC] - Beanie's Brunch Bunch for a chilled ride around the virtual roads of Zwift. Each week the course will vary so, whether you're a beginner just starting out on your first group rides, recovering from injury, or just looking for a steady paced ride then come and join us. name: PACK🐺 1.5 Morning Cuppa
description:
This PACK 1.5 beginner friendly event is aimed at Zwifters looking for a group ride experience at an average lap pace of around 1.3-1.5w/kg.

name: 🏆 TOUR OF WATOPIA BY HISP · ETAPA 6 · LA ETAPA REINA
description:
La sorpresa ya tiene nombre: dejamos Watopia y viajamos a Italia para el gran final del Tour. 🇮🇹

📍 Bologna TT · 24,6 km · vuelta y media con final en alto

Un recorrido inspirado en la contrarreloj que abrió el Giro de Italia de 2019, por las calles de Bolonia y con la mítica subida al santuario de San Luca como juez final. Tendrás que pasar dos veces por esas rampas: la primera para medir fuerzas y la segunda para dejarlo todo en la línea de meta, arriba del todo.

Aquí no hay sitio donde esconderse. Dosifica en el llano, guarda piernas para el muro y vacía el depósito en la última subida. La General se decide aquí. 🔥

✅ Recuerda:
• Solo cuentan las carreras de esta etapa listadas en hispevents.com
• Cuenta tu mejor tiempo de la semana: puedes repetir
• Imprescindible potenciómetro real o rodillo inteligente, y pulsómetro
• Para entrar en la General final hay que haber completado las 6 etapas

Clasificación y carreras válidas 👉 hispevents.com
¡Nos vemos en San Luca! 💚❤️


The surprise already has a name: we leave Watopia and travel to Italy for the grand finale of the Tour. 🇮🇹

📍 Bologna TT · 24.6 km · one and a half laps with a summit finish

A route inspired by the time trial that opened the 2019 Giro d'Italia, through the streets of Bologna and with the mythical climb to the Sanctuary of San Luca as the final judge. You'll have to tackle those ramps twice: the first time to gauge your strength and the second to leave everything on the finish line, right at the top.

There's nowhere to hide here. Pace yourself on the flat, save your legs for the wall and empty the tank on the final climb. The General Classification is decided here. 🔥

✅ Remember:
• Only the races of this stage listed on hispevents.com count
• Your best time of the week counts: you can repeat it
• Real power meter or smart trainer, and heart rate monitor essential
• To enter the final General Classification you must have completed all 6 stages

Classification and valid races 👉 hispevents.com

See you at San Luca! 💚❤️

name: DIRT 505 Friday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Friday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Fridays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 90 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

One of our regular SCP routes is 3.5 laps of Innsbruckring, with 4x Leg Snappers plus 3x sprints (stopping to regroup on the kicker in between). The challenge is to achieve sub 4 mins for the sum of 7 segment times for cats A/B (that's 45 secs per snapper plus 20 secs per sprint), sub 5 mins for cat C, and sub 7 mins for cat D. Best time to beat is 3:33.
Historical results for Leg Snapper: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1322

name: DIRT Friday Morning Sprintapalooza v2
description:
Welcome to the DIRT Friday Morning Sprintapalooza!

Please join us weekly on Fridays to stretch those sprinting muscles with
some of the fastest on Zwift. The beacon will ride at a consistent 2.5w/kg
and call out sprints, typically hitting 4 to 8 per ride. Power-ups are
limited to aero only and our large bunch results in relaxed recovery and a
big, drafty lead-in. You smash the sprint, sag to the beacon, recover, and
repeat!! We will typically ride the same route for several weeks, giving
you a chance to dial in the optimal start location for each sprint, before
moving on to a new location. We will try to highlight popular race routes
and get practice in for upcoming ZRL race locations. Are you strong enough
to be counted in the top 3 this week?!

Our ride includes a 30 minute late join option, so jump in with us and
don’t be afraid of losing your wheel.

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Indoors Riding Trainers. Our group exists
to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time
zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a
team culture of unity in the cycling community, especially among moms and
dads who put personal fitness and health high on their agenda.

https://www.strava.com/clubs/zwiftdirt

FACEBOOK DIRT GROUP:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftdirt

name: GRIT - HARD TRUTH
description:
Welcome to the Hard Truth climb. This ride will always cover long climbs on big mountains.
We invite you to take training to the next level by adding this ride to your weekly routine. Steep climbs are hard and long steep climbs are really hard, that is the Hard Truth of this ride.

The ride will start with a friendly group ride format with riders staying together before the big climbs start. Enjoy this social time on the ride before the Hard Truth of the climb arrives.

On climbs, strong riders at the front will push the pace and ride at race pace to compete for the win and the best KOM time. Strong riders at the front will likely output over 5 wpk on the climb.

To keep with a more social ride format, many riders will form a group and ride together on the climb. This social group will likely be using power typical of a Cat B ride. Riders are encouraged to find a group and ride together to help each other survive the Hard Truth of these big climbs.

name: KISS at Base Training Ride
description:
Join us to work on your endurance and power output at your aerobic threshold (AT) in Zone 2. The exercise will give you endurance and increased performance using fat as energy. A well-developed AT can give you better race performance increase the amount of time before your body uses glycogen stores.

We are now offering three separate paced rides to better accommodate various fitness levels.

The B Cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 3.2 - 3.99 w/kg.
The C Cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.5 - 3.19 w/kg.
The D Cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.2 - 2.49 w/kg.

Remember this when you approach hills and inclines along the way. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob.

So turn on your graph (press G on computer keyboard or select it from on-screen menu in iOS and Android) and paint it blue. Give the body a good foundation for Zwift racing. Discord server Link: https://discord.gg/kBmXhY2

name: CRYO-GEN Peaky Friday.
description:
The CRYO-GEN Peaky Friday Ride is a social ride for everyone who enjoys a
good climb, with plenty of rolling routes mixed in for variety. Join us
each Friday for a friendly, social spin that offers something for every
type of rider.

Whether you’re a steady D cat rider looking for supportive group miles and
a bit of extra hill practice, or a stronger rider after a fun, relaxed spin
with the option to stretch your legs on the climbs, you’ll find your place
on The Peaky Friday Ride. It’s all about teamwork, good vibes, and enjoying
the ride together, wherever the road takes us!

The yellow beacon will pace at around 2.2 w/kg on the flats and 2.5 w/kg on
the climbs. At times, we’ll turn off the fence and open up a free-pace
section, giving everyone the chance to push harder if they wish, or simply
ride steady with the yellow beacon, who will always maintain the advertised
pace. We regroup at the KOM banner, with plenty of notice before the fence
is reactivated, so everyone can come back together and enjoy the ride as a
group.

For those who enjoy a touch of luxury, we even have a Limo Service run by a
member of the sweep team! This friendly gruppetto offers a more relaxed
pace when needed, ensuring everyone can enjoy the ride at their own rhythm.

All we ask is that you respect the ride leader, help where you can, and
keep it fun and social. We hope you will join us on the hills!

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the
first time to ensure that their health should always take precedence over
completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP

NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet)
contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

name: Tullio Turbo Lunch
description:
Welcome to the Tullio Turbo Lunch race series. These races are designed to offer an ‘active lunch’ and a quick, intense workout during your working day.

Each race will last for circa 30 minutes, with time to warm up beforehand if taking a 12.30pm lunch or earlier. Join in on both a Monday and Friday lunchtime at 12.45pm, and get those calories burned. What a great way to start or end the week, and keeping that mind and body focussed for the working afternoon.

Tullio CC is the UK wide business community for cyclists; centred around business and networking on the bike. Head to www.tullio.cc to find out more, or become a member and enjoy ample benefits, along with our regular rides and events across the UK.

name: USMeS Friday Formation
description:
Welcome to USMeS - Friday Formation!
Line up, loosen up, and enjoy a ride that lets you have a little fun while keeping it tight. This is a chance to wake the legs, enjoy the group, and set yourself up either for Rapid Fire, 35min after this ride ends, or maybe to roll into the weekend feeling sharp instead of flat.
Ride it smooth -- ride it smart -- and -- ride it together.

✅ Pace: an average of 1.8–2.2 w/kg
✅ Duration: 60 minutes

Segments are encouraged. We do push on climbs, and when the pace lifts, make your move then fall back in Formation quickly and help keep the group together.

The goal is a clean, organized ride that flows as one... FORMATION!!
Respect the leader. Respect the pace. Protect the group.
Now Fall In & Hold Formation.

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: TGIF DIRTy Goats
description:
If screaming legs and burning lungs make you smile. Welcome to DIRTy Goats.

Every Friday, we encourage you to leave the flats behind and embrace the challenge of the weekly KOM.

An inclusive ride for all wanting to improve their mental toughness, develop climbing technique or simply badge hunt the routes you frequently choose to avoid. DIRTy Goats is the team to motivate you out of your comfort zone.

If you are daunted by the DIRTy Goats, Yellow beacon will stay within the ride limits. Our pace is based on a 75kg rider, riding 2.6w/kg or 195 watts on the flat, and 3.5w/kg or 260 watts on the climb. Lighter and heavier riders wanting to pace with the Leader are asked to adjust their power to work together.

Each ride will target 1000 vertical meters. This is not always achievable within our 90 minute ride, but the team will often keep rolling until we hit our goal.

Stronger riders are encouraged to work with the beacons to help the group. But if you really must fly, we ask that you move away quickly during the warm-up to avoid pulling the front.

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Inside Riding Trainers. This group has grown and brought like-minded moms and dads together who love to make time for Zwift around work and family.

Please join us on discord: https://discord.gg/sUnwqPZ

And Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZWIFTDIRT

name: Bike MS - Banded Eventful 40 Friday
description:
In addition to our monthly dual jersey unlock rides Bike MS is all about exploring together, so let's explore those event only routes. This 40 minute group ride will rotate different routes for those badge hunters out there. Lead beacon will ride around 2.0, but come for the journey and unlock a kit along the way. 
Bike MS Season if right around the corner, so let's connect over a ride as we prepare for the adventures ahead. Multiple Sclerosis does not stop, so neither will we as we ride together for this great cause.
Bike MS is the largest charity cycling series across the United States consisting of 50 rides and raising over $50 million in 2023 for the National MS Society. Bike MS supports the National MS Society's mission to Cure MS while empowering all people affected by MS to live their best lives. Whether you want to cross the Finish Line in person or take on a new challenge from anywhere — there’s a Bike MS event that’s right for you! 
Check out www.bikeMS.org and experience the ride of your life. Use Zwift24 for a discount on your Bike MS Ride entry fee.
Come join us for weekly Club Rides: Bike MS ZC

name: SROZ's No Watt Left Behind
description:
Welcome to the ride where fitness is irrelevant and physics is a lie.

Thanks to Zwift’s magical rubber band, we are all bound together in mandatory, artificial harmony.

Whether you’re pushing 5 W/kg or barely stirring your coffee while spinning at 40 Watts, congratulations: you’re staying with the group.

The Rules of Engagement:
The band keeps us together, but if you drop to 0 Watts, you become an anchor dragging the entire group into the abyss. Keep the legs moving.

Flyers Will Be Teleported:
Try to break away all you want. The algorithm will simply drag you back like a leash on an unruly puppy.

Save the sprint for a ride where the game actually lets you leave people behind. Today, we suffer at the exact same virtual coordinate.

Spin easy, chat in the comments, and remember to pay it forward!

name: Zwift Runner's Walk/Run Intervals
description:
PLEASE DO NOT ENTER THIS EVENT UNLESS YOU ARE HAPPY TO FOLLOW THE SPECIFIC RUN INSTRUCTIONS BELOW.

This event is designed to be run as a group with the emphasis on all finishing together.  

The run will be formed of a series of Walk/Run intervals.  The run interval will be for 90 seconds at at speed of 5mph (8kph) which is a pace of 12:00 min/mile (7:30min/km).  The walk will be for 60 seconds at 3.2mph (5.1kph) which is a pace of 11:45 min/km 18:45 min/mile (11:45 min/km).

When there is a group leader present, the workout may be spiced up a bit.  Expect treadmill incline challenges, speed surges, and mini chases using the specified intervals as a base pace.   You can choose to just stick to the base workout or join in on the fun of the challenge.  

Every effort will be made to try to keep the group together.

Please get your treadmills to speed and start running 30 seconds before the event start to ensure we all get off the line together.  Don't worry, you can run in the start pen on a virtual treadmill.

NOTE - If joining this event it is important that you are willing to compromise your own speed to ensure everyone running has an enjoyable experience.

name: ZZRC Latte 2-2.5 Group Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Latte 2-2.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2-2.5 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised.

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app.

Teamwork makes the ride work.

eventSubgroups.description:
YAY! You finished the week. No need to race into the weekend, start it off with an easy ride, socializing and celebrating the Bicycle Way of Life.  Join us every Friday to sip your coffee or tea… hey it's morning for us… and socialize. Talk about bikes, about your favorite roads or trails. Perhaps even share a cake recipe?

The average speed will be 21 mph-23 mph (34 kph-36 kph) flat sections, dropping on climbs as the ride lead targets an effort of 1.8 to 1.9 wpk. The lead will keep the pace and stronger riders will be there to help as needed.  We always plan to provide lead and sweep support, but there will be times where that will not be the case.  You are encouraged to pace with the ride leader/yellow beacon, but if they are not able to make the ride, or if you find the pace too quick, drop off, group up, work together with those around you.  Teamwork makes the ride work.  

Want to know more about us? Bicycle Way of Life (bicycleway.com) is a local bike store chain in Eugene, Oregon. We encourage new and experienced riders to support each other indoors and out, fixing trails or just their bikes.
Interact and find more info. by joining our FB group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/bwolzwift
Look us up on Strava https://www.strava.com/clubs/bicycleway-com, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/bicyclewayoflife/, and Facebook https://www.facebook.com/bicycleway/

name: Friday Freight Train
description:
Join Team Endurance Nation for a great weekend kick off ride! This session focuses on steady state riding and is a great way to build up some mileage. All riders are welcome to join this event and be part of our group riding community within Zwift. Feel free to keep riding after the finish to rack up more miles with the group!

Warm Up: Very short. Just enough to build the group.
Main Ride: Steady riding at 2.5 w/kg. Overall average including climbs and finish should be 2.7 w/kg.

TeamEN members chat on an app called Discord. Discord is not required, but the ride experience is enhanced by using it. Click on this link for more information about Discord and related setup: https://www.endurancenation.us/teamen-on-zwift#discord

For more specifics about this ride and various other Endurance Nation rides, go to: https://www.endurancenation.us/teamen-on-zwift

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: BST Mountaingoat Race
description:
The race is for everyone who wants a good, high quality workout and competition with likeminded people. Remember to pace yourself, there will
be climbs to conquer. The race should be as fair as possible so the following rules apply. Racers on zPower, lacking heart rate monitors, riding in an inappropriate category, or riding very unrealistically will be disqualified. Powerups are turned off as well. 

Final results will be available on zwiftpower.com. So get your bottles and turn on your fan, it's race time! 

When you sign up please select the correct category below (your FTP divided by your weight in kg):
(A) 4.0+ W/kg FTP
(B) 3.2 - 3.99 W/kg FTP
(C) 2.5 - 3.19 W/kg FTP
(D) 0 - 2.49 W/kg FTP
(E) Women Only

description:
Hello Friday! Celebrate the end of the work week with a quick 5K. Walk it, run it or race it. You are welcome to run at your own pace (AYOP). It’s up to you!

Epic Run Crew is based in Vancouver, BC, Canada. We were founded as an in-person club in 2021 and then joined Zwift in June 2022.

Use the Zwift Companion app to join the Epic Run Crew club, for access to exclusive member-only group runs.

name: Zwift Racing: Racing 101
description:
Ready to cross the start line but not sure what to expect? Zwift Racing: Racing 101 helps you build the skills and confidence to take on your first race.

Designed for beginners and curious riders, this guided ride breaks down the fundamentals in a friendly, low-pressure environment. Learn what to expect at the start, how to make the most of the draft, use PowerUps and manage your effort. You’ll also discover four different ways to race, so you can start finding your place in racing.

name: 🏆 TOUR OF WATOPIA BY HISP · ETAPA 6 · LA ETAPA REINA
description:
La sorpresa ya tiene nombre: dejamos Watopia y viajamos a Italia para el gran final del Tour. 🇮🇹

📍 Bologna TT · 24,6 km · vuelta y media con final en alto

Un recorrido inspirado en la contrarreloj que abrió el Giro de Italia de 2019, por las calles de Bolonia y con la mítica subida al santuario de San Luca como juez final. Tendrás que pasar dos veces por esas rampas: la primera para medir fuerzas y la segunda para dejarlo todo en la línea de meta, arriba del todo.

Aquí no hay sitio donde esconderse. Dosifica en el llano, guarda piernas para el muro y vacía el depósito en la última subida. La General se decide aquí. 🔥

✅ Recuerda:
• Solo cuentan las carreras de esta etapa listadas en hispevents.com
• Cuenta tu mejor tiempo de la semana: puedes repetir
• Imprescindible potenciómetro real o rodillo inteligente, y pulsómetro
• Para entrar en la General final hay que haber completado las 6 etapas

Clasificación y carreras válidas 👉 hispevents.com
¡Nos vemos en San Luca! 💚❤️


The surprise already has a name: we leave Watopia and travel to Italy for the grand finale of the Tour. 🇮🇹

📍 Bologna TT · 24.6 km · one and a half laps with a summit finish

A route inspired by the time trial that opened the 2019 Giro d'Italia, through the streets of Bologna and with the mythical climb to the Sanctuary of San Luca as the final judge. You'll have to tackle those ramps twice: the first time to gauge your strength and the second to leave everything on the finish line, right at the top.

There's nowhere to hide here. Pace yourself on the flat, save your legs for the wall and empty the tank on the final climb. The General Classification is decided here. 🔥

✅ Remember:
• Only the races of this stage listed on hispevents.com count
• Your best time of the week counts: you can repeat it
• Real power meter or smart trainer, and heart rate monitor essential
• To enter the final General Classification you must have completed all 6 stages

Classification and valid races 👉 hispevents.com

See you at San Luca! 💚❤️
